name: Colorado Springs

neighborhoods.name: Old North End
neighborhoods.homes: large historic houses, some split into apartments

housing: Colorado Springs rentals are mostly single-family houses and apartment complexes, with many leases tied to the city's military bases.

tenantHelp.name: Colorado Legal Services
tenantHelp.what: free legal help and renters' rights workshops

climate: Hailstorms are common, so photograph the roof, windows and siding; test the furnace, and check for drafts since the city sits above 6,000 feet with cold winters.
fact: Fort Carson, the Air Force Academy and the Space Force bases bring frequent military moves, so many leases include a military clause.
